milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the task is to mine green stained glass, and the mined drop ends up in the player's inventory. The scene provides a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe in the player's main hand via /replaceitem, ensuring the glass block drops as an item when broken (without Silk Touch, glass shatters and drops nothing). We check that the player has at least 1 green_stained_glass in their inventory, confirming they successfully mined a block.
